page.home.title: Mantén tu pantalla despierta — AwakeTab
page.home.description: Mantén tu pantalla despierta en esta pestaña del navegador con la API Wake Lock. Estado honesto, duraciones predefinidas, hasta una hora. Sin cuenta.
page.home.what.title: Qué hace AwakeTab
page.home.how.title: Cómo funciona
page.home.limits.title: Límites honestos

page.home.intro: AwakeTab usa la API Wake Lock del navegador mientras esta pestaña está visible, y el estado solo dice que la pantalla está despierta después de que el navegador confirma el bloqueo.
page.home.uses.title: What are you keeping awake?
page.home.uses.lead: Each one opens the tool already set for the job, with the length it needs.
page.home.uses.cooking.body: The recipe stays lit while your hands are floury, with kitchen timers beside it.
page.home.uses.reading.body: A long article stays on screen while you read, with no tap to wake it.
page.home.uses.presentations.body: Set it to the end of your talk and keep it in a floating window beside the slides.
page.home.uses.dashboards.body: A wall screen stays on all day, and a link can start the session as the page loads.
page.home.uses.videoCalls.body: The display stays on when the video pauses. Your chat status is left alone.
page.home.uses.downloads.body: The screen stays on through a long download, and a visible tab holds off idle sleep.
page.home.final.title: One tap, and the screen stays on.
page.home.final.body: The pill says {held} only after the browser confirms the lock. For a hidden tab or a minimised window, the extension keeps going.
page.home.final.docs: How it works, limits and FAQ in the docs
page.home.ext.title: Keep the screen awake with the tab out of sight
page.home.ext.lead: The extension asks the browser itself to keep the screen awake, so it keeps going behind other windows.
page.home.ext.hidden.title: Tab hidden or window minimised
page.home.ext.hidden.body: It keeps going while the browser is running.
page.home.ext.system.title: Only the system, if you prefer
page.home.ext.system.body: System level keeps the computer awake and lets the screen dim or turn off.
page.home.ext.badge.title: Status in the toolbar
page.home.ext.badge.body: The badge shows ON, SYS or the minutes left.
page.home.ext.shortcut.title: A shortcut from any tab
page.home.ext.shortcut.body: {keys} starts or stops it without going back to the tab.
page.home.ext.note: Works in {browsers}, version {version} or later. {others} have no power API for extensions.
page.home.levels.title: Choose your level
page.home.levels.lead: Keeping a screen awake is free, in this tab and in the extension. Pro changes how AwakeTab looks and what it remembers.
page.home.levels.web.name: Web tab
page.home.levels.web.sub: Runs right here, in this tab.
page.home.levels.web.g1: Keeps the screen on while this tab is visible
page.home.levels.web.g2: 15 min to 4 h, until a time, or a custom length up to 7 days
page.home.levels.web.g3: Phones, tablets and computers, and offline after the first visit
page.home.levels.web.g4: A status pill that says awake only once the browser confirms it
page.home.levels.ext.name: Extension
page.home.levels.ext.g1: Keeps going with the tab hidden or the window minimised
page.home.levels.ext.g2: Screen or System: keep only the computer awake and let the screen sleep

page.pro.title: AwakeTab Pro plans and pricing — AwakeTab
page.pro.description: AwakeTab Pro adds lamp colours, Message mode, 12 weeks of stats and extension schedules. Yearly or pay once, 5 devices, 14-day refund, no account.
page.pro.lead: Pro is optional. The awake screen stays honest and ad-free either way. Polar handles checkout; AwakeTab never stores a password.
page.pro.tax: Charged in USD; taxes added at checkout where applicable.
page.pro.refund: 14-day refund, no questions asked. Email support@awaketab.com with your receipt or use the Polar customer portal. Refunds deactivate the licence key.
page.pro.activate.title: Activate AwakeTab Pro — AwakeTab
page.pro.activate.description: Paste the licence key from your Polar receipt to activate AwakeTab Pro on this device. Checkout returns here automatically when Polar finishes.
page.pro.activate.lead: Your key is in the email from Polar and on the receipt page. This device counts as one of five activations.
page.pro.activate.ext: Copy this key and paste it in the AwakeTab for Chrome options page. There is no automatic hand-off.
page.pro.activate.ext.title: Your licence key
page.pro.activate.ext.lead: Enter your key here to copy it into AwakeTab for Chrome. This browser is not activated: the extension activates itself, so it uses one of your five activations, not two.
page.pro.manage.title: Manage Pro devices — AwakeTab
page.pro.manage.description: See which devices hold your AwakeTab Pro licence and remove one if you have reached the five-device limit.
page.pro.manage.lead: Devices unused for 90 days are removed automatically when you activate a new one.
page.pro.manage.empty: No licence on this device yet. Activate a key first.
page.pro.manage.confirm.here: Remove this device? Pro switches off here and frees one of your five activations.

page.pro.checkout.failed.l1: Check the card number, expiry date and billing postcode.
page.pro.checkout.failed.l2: Some banks hold the first payment to a new shop. Approving it in your bank’s app usually clears it.
page.pro.checkout.failed.l3: Try another card or payment method. Taxes are added at checkout, so the total can be above the list price.

page.pro.checkout.help.l2: Just paid? Polar takes a few seconds to create the key. The activation page keeps checking for about 20 seconds on its own.
page.pro.checkout.help.l3: Keys and receipts are also in the Polar customer portal.
page.pro.checkout.help.l4: Still stuck? Email support@awaketab.com from the address you paid with.

page.pro.eve.lead: Pro changes what AwakeTab looks like and remembers, never how the screen is kept awake.
page.pro.msg.h3: Your words on the awake screen
page.pro.msg.body: Message mode puts your own line, up to 80 characters, in big type on the awake screen. Anyone can try it free for 60 seconds.

page.pro.msg.caption: Preview of Message mode on the awake screen

page.pro.night.free: {name} is one of the free colours.

page.pro.hist.body: Free stats show the last 7 days. Pro keeps 12 weeks and exports your sessions as CSV, so you can see what really ran and for how long.

page.pro.wall.body: In AwakeTab for Chrome, pick the days and hours a screen stays on, or start whenever Chrome opens. Nobody has to touch it.
page.pro.sch.title: Schedule
page.pro.sch.none: No days picked, so this screen follows its normal sleep settings.
page.pro.sch.every: Awake every day, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, then lets the screen sleep.
page.pro.sch.line: Awake {span}, 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM, then lets the screen sleep.
page.pro.plans.lead: Both plans unlock everything above, plus no ads on the guides, on 5 devices. There is no monthly plan and no account.
page.pro.plans.renews: Renews yearly through Polar. Cancel any time.

page.pro.plans.after.value: Less than three years of the yearly plan.

page.pro.refund.rest: Email support@awaketab.com with your receipt or use the Polar customer portal. Refunds deactivate the licence key.
page.pro.free.lead: Keeping a screen awake never needs Pro. The status pill only says what the browser really did, in all seven states:
page.pro.free.also: Also free: every length from 15 min to 4 h, until I stop, until a time or a custom length up to 7 days; all four clock faces; every ambient mode (Standard, Clock, Focus, Minimal, Night and Cook); Aqua and Violet; 7 days of stats; AwakeTab for Chrome at Screen or System level; offline install in 8 languages. No ads on the awake screen, now or later.
page.pro.faq.q1: Does Pro keep the screen awake better?
page.pro.faq.a1: No. Free and Pro use the same wake lock and the same status pill. Pro adds colours, a message, history and schedules on top.
page.pro.faq.a2: No. Polar handles checkout and emails you a licence key. AwakeTab never stores a password.
page.pro.faq.a3: Each browser where you enter the key uses one of five activations. AwakeTab for Chrome activates itself and uses one too. Devices unused for 90 days are removed automatically when you activate a new one.
page.pro.faq.a4: 14-day refund, no questions asked. Email support@awaketab.com with your receipt or use the Polar customer portal. Refunds deactivate the licence key.

ext.about.title: Acerca de
page.extension.title: Extensión de Chrome para mantener la pantalla despierta — AwakeTab
page.extension.description: AwakeTab for Chrome mantiene la pantalla o el ordenador despiertos desde la barra, aunque la pestaña esté oculta. Temporizadores, horarios y sin rastreo.
page.extension.lead: La app web solo puede mantener el bloqueo de activación mientras su pestaña está visible. La extensión le pide a Chrome que mantenga despierta la pantalla —o solo el ordenador—, así que sigue funcionando con la pestaña oculta o la ventana minimizada.
page.extension.cta.edgeSearch: Buscar en los complementos de Edge
page.extension.cta.pending: La ficha está pendiente de revisión, así que por ahora estos botones abren una búsqueda en la tienda.
page.extension.firefox.title: ¿Usas Firefox o Safari?
page.extension.firefox.body: Firefox y Safari no ofrecen a las extensiones una API de energía, así que no hay extensión de AwakeTab para ellos. La app web mantiene la pantalla despierta mientras su pestaña está visible.
page.extension.features.title: Qué hace
page.extension.features.levels: Pantalla o Sistema: mantén la pantalla encendida o solo el ordenador despierto y deja que la pantalla se atenúe.
page.extension.features.timers: Los mismos ajustes que la app web: de 15 minutos a 4 horas, hasta una hora concreta o hasta que lo detengas.
page.extension.features.badge: La insignia de la barra muestra ON, SYS o los minutos restantes, y Alt+Shift+A lo activa o desactiva desde cualquier pestaña.
page.extension.features.pro: Con Pro: horarios semanales e inicio automático al abrir Chrome o al visitar un sitio que elijas.
page.extension.limits.running: Solo funciona mientras Chrome está abierto.
page.extension.limits.lid: No puede evitar la suspensión al cerrar la tapa del portátil.
page.extension.limits.presence: No hace que Teams o Slack te muestren como disponible: la presencia depende de tu teclado y ratón, y AwakeTab nunca simula actividad.
page.extension.permissions.title: Permisos y para qué sirven
page.extension.permissions.power: power: mantener despierta la pantalla o el sistema.
page.extension.permissions.storage: storage: guardar tu configuración y la sesión actual.
page.extension.permissions.alarms: alarms: hacer funcionar temporizadores y horarios mientras el proceso en segundo plano duerme.
page.extension.permissions.notifications: notifications (opcional): avisarte cuando termina un temporizador.
page.extension.permissions.sites: Acceso a sitios (opcional, de uno en uno): iniciar automáticamente en los sitios que elijas. Sin acceso a sitios por defecto.
page.extension.privacy: Las estadísticas de uso anónimas están desactivadas por defecto. La extensión nunca envía URL, títulos de pestañas ni nombres de sitios, y no muestra anuncios.
page.extension.web: ¿Prefieres no instalar nada? La app web mantiene la pantalla despierta mientras su pestaña está visible.

page.extension.compare.title: Tab or extension
page.extension.steps.title: Ready in three steps
page.extension.steps.install.title: Install
page.extension.steps.install.body: Add it from the Chrome Web Store, or from Edge Add-ons in Edge.
page.extension.steps.pin.title: Pin it
page.extension.steps.pin.body: Open the Extensions menu (the puzzle piece) and pin AwakeTab, so its badge stays in view.
page.extension.steps.press.title: Press the shortcut
page.extension.steps.press.body: From any tab, it starts your usual length. Press it again to stop. On a Mac, Alt is the Option key.
page.extension.permissions.lead: Three it needs to work, two you can turn on. It gets no site access unless you pick a site.
page.extension.faq.title: Questions
page.extension.faq.a1: Yes. Timers, Screen or System, the toolbar badge and the shortcut are free. Pro adds weekly schedules and auto-start.
page.extension.faq.q2: Can it see the sites I visit?
page.extension.faq.a2: No. It has no site access by default and never sends URLs, tab titles or site names. Auto-start on a site, a Pro feature, asks for access to that one site.
page.extension.faq.q3: Why not just use the web app?
page.extension.faq.a3: The web app keeps the screen awake only while its tab is visible. The extension keeps going while you work in other tabs or with the window minimised, as long as Chrome is running.
page.extension.faq.a4: Yes. Open chrome://extensions/shortcuts in Chrome, or edge://extensions/shortcuts in Edge, and set your own. Do that too if another extension already uses Alt+Shift+A.

tool.why.title: Cómo lo sabe AwakeTab
tool.why.timerD: Se basa en el reloj del sistema, así que una laptop que se suspendió vuelve con una cifra real, no una desfasada.
tool.why.powerD: Los navegadores no los informan. En iPhone, el Modo de bajo consumo fuerza un bloqueo automático de 30 segundos aunque el indicador diga que está despierta.
tool.why.tabVisible: Visible. Si cambias de pestaña, el navegador retira el Wake Lock y el indicador lo muestra.
tool.why.lockReady: Aún no se ha solicitado. Nada mantiene la pantalla encendida hasta que toques Mantener despierta.
tool.why.tabReady: Los navegadores solo conceden un Wake Lock a una pestaña visible.
tool.why.lockEnded: Liberado a las {time} al terminar la sesión. La pantalla ya puede apagarse.
tool.why.lockStarting: Solicitado a tu navegador a las {time}. Esperando su respuesta.
tool.why.lockPaused: El navegador lo liberó a las {time}, al ocultarse esta pestaña. La pantalla puede apagarse.
tool.why.tabPaused: Oculta. Vuelve y AwakeTab pedirá el Wake Lock de nuevo por sí solo.
tool.why.lockBlocked: El navegador lo rechazó a las {time}. Ahora mismo nada mantiene la pantalla encendida.
tool.why.causesD: La pestaña no estaba al frente, Safari necesita un toque primero, o Firefox está con 5% de batería o menos. La solución está abajo.
tool.why.lockNone: Este navegador no tiene la API Screen Wake Lock, así que no hay nada que solicitar.
tool.why.videoTap: Listo, pero necesita un toque para reproducirse. Necesita esta pestaña visible y usa un poco más de batería.
tool.why.videoOn: Se está reproduciendo un video silenciado de un solo fotograma que mantiene la pantalla encendida. Necesita esta pestaña visible y usa un poco más de batería.
tool.why.tabVideo: Visible. El video se detiene si la pestaña se oculta, y el indicador lo mostrará.
